about_short_description.short_description: Viki is a  prime-time entertainment to new audiences and unlocks new markets and revenue opportunities for content owners.

product.name: Rakuten Viki
product.description: A streaming platform for Korean, Chinese, Japanese, and other Asian television programs and movies, offering free and paid viewing with multilingual subtitles across web, mobile, and connected-TV devices.

product.name: Viki Pass
product.description: A paid subscription service that provides ad-free, higher-quality streaming and access to additional Viki programs and movies, with Standard and Plus plan options.

product.name: Viki Movie Rentals
product.description: A transactional video-on-demand service that lets viewers rent selected premium movies and watch them within a defined rental period, without requiring a Viki Pass subscription.

product.name: Content Distribution Partnerships
product.description: A distribution service that helps content owners and distributors reach international audiences through Viki’s streaming platform, subtitle community, and global consumer network.

product.name: Advertising Solutions
product.description: Advertising inventory and partnership solutions that enable brands to reach Viki’s global audience through advertising placements associated with its streaming content.

product.name: Viki Subtitle Community
product.description: A community-based subtitling service in which contributors create and translate subtitles for Viki programs, enabling multilingual access to international television and film content.
